title: Grand Bazaar of Petaluma
description: Join us at the Grand Bazaar of Petaluma Fri, Sat & Sun Oct 2, 3, & 4 at the Petaluma Fairgrounds. * 125+ Artists & Crafters * Food, Fun, Shopping & Creative Ideas.  Event & Raffle Proceeds benefit MICAH'S HUGS, an inspiring local drug awareness charity. Join us for an exciting event showcasing a unique mix of creative treasures — including festive holiday décor, hand-crafted creations, one-of-a-kind gifts, and personal care and indulgences. Different vendors each day brings something new to explore! Free parking & free shuttle.

title: 1st Annual North Bay Craft Bash Craft Fair
description: Mark your calendar! Join us at the Annual North Bay Craft Bash craft fair! Saturday September 5th from 10-5 at the Santa Rosa Memorial Vet Building!  Shop unique handmade goods, support local artisans and find one of kind gifts! Get your holiday shopping started early!   Don’t forget to grab your Sax’s Joint Cinnamon rolls!!!   We can’t wait to see you all! Annual North Bay Craft Bash #northBayCraftBash #handmade #labordayweekend. #shopsmall
